Senses.Explanation: To open a single line of passage is to relax a total blockade just enough for speech, movement, or a second-level explanation. The narrow opening is controlled permission, not unrestricted freedom. Huangbo holds all the old masters in his fist and says that if he opens one line, people may move freely in every direction. In the source exchange the questioner asks what happens when Huangbo opens the line; Huangbo answers “seven vertical, eight horizontal.” Asked for the mouth with which he teaches, Kaixian answers “open a single line.” Yuanwu says that when the first mechanism has not been recognized, he must open one line and speak through the second gate.
